shortDescription: Membership registration and search landing screen.
fullDescription: Main membership management view with a branded top bar, two large action cards for starting a new membership or reviewing pending processes, a centered search form for locating existing member profiles by personal details or membership number, and an empty-result state with a call to create a new membership. The view composes shared button, card, input, empty-state, and separator primitives and uses the global semantic token layer for its light visual theme.
